storyline.real: Hamilton leads from pole. Räikkönen and then Hamilton stop early for softs while Vettel stays out. Both Haas cars retire after their stops with loosely fitted wheels, and under the virtual safety car for Grosjean's car Vettel makes his only stop and comes out ahead of Hamilton. Hamilton stays second to the flag, and Vettel wins by 5.036 s.

eras.briefing: Melbourne, 2018. Hamilton leads from pole with Räikkönen second, and you run Vettel in third, sixteen laps in. Räikkönen and Hamilton will stop before you. Stay out longer than they do and find a way to come out ahead of Hamilton without having to pass him on the track.
